meaning: Bind an existing checked project composition to exact selected native Calculation modules without changing authored behavior or domain meaning.
scope: A pure additive R07 binding plan, not a public compiler cutover, publisher, HTTP launcher, provider executor or stronger verification receipt. The checked source graph may contain domain nodes outside the selected native view; every invoked Calculation must be selected.
inputs: Require a registered immutable source-bound graph and registered resolved artifact plan with the exact same full certificate and source manifest, and these pinned definition bytes. Reject fabricated, mutated, stale or foreign inputs.
composition: Preserve each checked domainspec.project-composition/v1 source, compiled behavior, ontology, bindings, dependency graph and provenance byte-for-byte. This TypeScript candidate accepts the existing node-http target only; rust-http and unsupported source bindings reject, never fall back.
bindings: Existing core record bindings are type/provenance bindings only. Do not call factories or invent invariant enforcement. Each authored Calculation alias binds a qualified typed-calculation/v1 selector, its existing ordered argument-to-core-field mapping and the unique public callable from a selected calculations-v1 generator request. No basename-only lookup, v2 coercion, inferred call or new canonical domain edge is permitted.
runtime: Emit a composition-local core-api.ts exporting evaluateCalculation(name,input), the seam already used by behavior.mjs. Imports target checked generated modules and bind their hashes. Dispatch preserves exact UInt64 values and selected native arithmetic failures. Reject unknown aliases and nonexact, accessor-bearing or nonenumerable argument objects without reading their values. The adapter does not evaluate expressions, execute behavior, integrations or transactions while planning.
artifacts: Composition artifacts and core-api.ts use compositions/<id>/ paths. Keep generated native module bytes and paths unchanged; reject unsafe paths, case-fold collisions and file-directory collisions across the combined inventory. This is a binding plan, not a complete application output layout.
evidence: Freeze and hash the exact additive artifact list, source definition, full graph identity, resolved-plan identity, ordered binding metadata and native import surfaces. An explicit validator reconstructs serialized evidence from checked inputs; a caller digest cannot revive a registered plan.
verification: nonempty core record plus renamed multi-argument Calculation bindings
distinct qualified selectors with the same local node name
native behavior with exact arithmetic and preserved failure semantics
source removal and relocation preserve checked plan
forged stale foreign and omitted generator selections reject without output writes
legacy composition artifacts and defaults remain unchanged
remaining: Public source/snapshot/CLI composition wiring, application output envelopes, source capsule integration and composition-aware stronger verification remain subsequent R08 work. No admission, approval, release or production effect is implied.
